track.title: Textures, materials, and gameplay-significant presentation semantics
track.purpose: Separate rendering metadata from gameplay-triggered presentation state and recover only supported identifiers, producers, consumers, runtime representations, references, lifecycle, serialization, and lookup chains.
questions: Which records address textures, rasters, materials, shaders, effects, and UI assets?
Which metadata is rendering-only, and which is selected or triggered by gameplay state?
Are team/faction, selection, visibility, masks, collision, terrain indicators, effects, and UI linked to texture identity?
What is intentionally divergent in OpenSpore?
track.clean_room_boundary: No SPORE inspection, payload bytes, proprietary source, decompiled-code reproduction, Ghidra mutation, KG mutation, or historical-artifact mutation is included.

covered: GMDL v8 material IDs and texture references
Raster envelope, DXT5 mips, alpha-mask use, and upload
MaterialShader, Material, CompiledState, TextureSlot, Texture, and Raster runtime structures
Cell GFX preload, effect maps, background maps, cell queries, UI rollover, terrain rendering, and faction color separation
OpenSpore B1/B2/B3 seams, lifecycle, persistence, and modern divergence
excluded: Raw PNG claims based only on the historical PNG32 name
Visual guesses and decompiler output treated as semantic truth
Unobserved original multi-package orchestration, runtime cell identity, and property serialization

key_findings.finding: GMDL material IDs and texture group/instance refs are material/rendering associations; no direct gameplay predicate is established.
The verified raster is a near-black alpha mask used for rendering compositing, not a team/faction or collision field.
Gameplay-triggered presentation runs through Cell GFX/effectMap/UI state; texture pixels are not shown to be the gameplay selector.
Cell query collision uses position, cell size, linked entries, and object-pool indices, with no recovered texture field.
Empire identity color is an independent gameplay path, not evidence of texture-encoded faction identity.
No original atlas table, packed rectangle, or UV-atlas contract was recovered; group/instance is the established resource identity.
